remarks: Well cared for Fieldstone colonial in most convenient location. Spacious rooms, living room with fireplace and hardwood floors, formal dining room,large newer eat-in-kitchen with pantry. Sliders open onto the durable maintenance free deck where you can enjoy outdoor dining while you watch loved ones play safely in the fenced in yard. Primary bedroom with tray ceiling, huge en-suite bath and walk in closet. The two additional bedrooms (with Jack and Jill bath) can easily each accommodate 2 persons. Steps away from Barrett Park, bus line, shopping and houses of worship. Fridge and freezer in garage are excluded.
